sections.title: Sound of the letter cappa
paragraphs: The letter name is (cappa) /ˈkappa/. This letter makes one sound. You hear it at the start of (kiwi) /ˈki.wi/, the small green fruit. It makes only this one sound.

sections.title: How to say cappa
paragraphs: Raise the back of your tongue against the soft roof of your mouth. Stop the air completely. Release the tongue suddenly so the air bursts out. Keep your vocal cords still. Put your hand on your throat. You feel no shaking. Hold a hand before your lips to feel only a tiny puff of air.

sections.title: Reading the letter cappa
paragraphs: This letter appears only in loanwords and borrowed foreign terms. It always makes the same sound. You hear it at the start of (kamikaze) /kamiˈkad.dze/.

sections.title: Tips for cappa
paragraphs: Do not release a heavy puff of air. In English, the consonant in kite sends out a burst of breath. Keep the release crisp and short. Hold a sheet of paper before your lips. The paper must barely move when you make the sound.
